title: a deleter's own order answers for a file deleted with no rename
intention: A file a build deleted outright, with no rename, resolves through the deleting ticket's own forwarding order for every ticket that charted it; a non-deleter's order still never answers for it.
why: Measured 2026-11-19 on akiendelllinux: e4a12d8e0cbf deleted press_office/CairnComponentOutline.txt (cairn 770decaf5, no rename) and forwarded it to cairn/devices/cairn/requirements/TOC.md, but continued_successor reads a deleter's order only at the end of a rename chain, so 109 constrain berths (constraint_traces) and 30 orient berths (charted_refs_resolve) across ~100 tickets, nearly all PROVED, stood red behind it, and 0c2c's crossing red on it. Copying the order onto every charting ticket re-derives an answer the deleter already gave. HYPOTHESIS: Reading the deleter's own order for a rename-less deletion is enough: every later dissolution resolves for its charting tickets with no copy written. CC's answer under outline 0.6.1; the WATCHME carries it back to cc_0.
traces_to: Law 1 (the resolver is spent on the novel, not on re-deriving the settled). Law 8: a non-deleter's order still never vouches for an address nothing chains it to.
how: In continued_successor (cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py), after key = _repo_relative(...): when key has no rename record, deleter = _deleting_ticket(key, repo_root) and to = _forwarding_map(deleter).get(key); answer dress(to) only if it exists, and never read _hand_order_index on this branch. Supersedes 96541ff420bc clause 4 for the deleter only: its tooth 4 (test_a_rename_chain_crosses_a_dissolution.py) keeps the half that survives, OTHER's order for z.py with the deleter silent answers None. New proof test_a_deleters_order_answers_for_an_outright_deletion.py carries the three clauses; the WATCHME probe berths at cairn/machines/build_inspector/probes/an_outright_deletion_resolves_through_its_deleter.py. Built on akienasus branch outline-fallback-draft (fac858474, dbdcfcad7).
constraints: a non-deleter's order never answers for an address with no rename record, alone or with every copy agreeing
the rename-chain branch of continued_successor and teeth 1-3 and 5-7 of 96541ff420bc are unchanged
the 6 hand copies already written for press_office/CairnComponentOutline.txt stay
